description: A smiling man in a grey baseball uniform with a dark cap and orange-trimmed piping runs along a dirt track beside a green padded wall. Fans lean over the wall with raised hands to slap his hand. Behind them is a dim, crowded stadium. The uniform and the stadium seating look mid-to-late 20th century. No legible letters are visible; the only marks are small orange logos on some fans' caps. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame, and nothing is gory.
